intro:
Beauty has interested humanity throughout our entire existence. Each generation perceives it in its own way, and beauty standards also change. Even 20 years ago, this concept was quite specific. If we talk about women, the ideal formula was considered to be thin, tall, and at the same time curvy. A man was considered handsome only if he had a lot of muscles and certain facial features. But humanity changes, as do beauty standards. Later, we came to body positivity, where any body is considered beautiful. But modern society is now dictating a different position, namely that health is beautiful.

We will talk about this and about how to improve your appearance by accepting it and improving your condition both externally and internally. Our experts have reviewed the latest works on beauty, learned the freshest news from the Biohacking beauty world, and are ready to tell you about them.
highlights: Biohacking beauty starts from internal health including nutrition sleep and stress management.
For biohacking skin you need a consistent routine with active ingredients and daily SPF protection.
To support healthy hair focus on scalp health and microcirculation.
Healthy posture and appearance are not only about health but also about perception by others.

blocks.text: What Is Biohacking Beauty?

It seems like cosmetology has existed for decades, so why complicate things and come up with a new name for it? The fact is that sometimes a problem should be looked at from a different angle. If in classical cosmetology we work with symptoms and try to treat them, then in the biohacking approach, the work begins with the problem itself. If the hair is brittle and not shiny, then specialists in longevity biohacking beauty begin research with tests and understanding which micro- and macronutrients the body lacks. Or, for example, the appearance of wrinkles begins to be considered from the point of view of the stress that a person experiences every day. Thus, we get a self-care formula that takes into account all life factors, and not just masks acquired symptoms. As a result, we get the adjustment of the work of the entire organism – from hormones to [circadian rhythms](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-your-circadian-rhythm). And beauty here is rather a side effect that manifests itself on its own from an improved lifestyle.
Beauty From Within

Cosmetic brands often advertise perfect skin, white teeth, and perfect nails thanks to their products. But if you look at their compositions, you can understand that this does not always work. Yes, of course, it is important to pay attention to the skin and add useful components to care, moisturise it, and peel. But this is far from everything that can affect its condition. The same applies to other points. No hair conditioner will be able to thicken hair if it initially grows thin and weakened. Each of these points must be regulated from within. Let’s consider the main points that will help you become more beautiful without spending a lot of money on luxury cosmetics.
Nutrition for Skin, Hair, and Beauty

[Proper and balanced nutrition](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-diet) is one of the pillars on which our planet of beauty and health stands. For proper nutrition, it is important to include all components: proteins, fats, and carbohydrates. Also, do not forget about Omega-3, it helps in building the tissues of nails and hair. Also, these polyunsaturated fatty acids affect immunity, and frequent illnesses also have a bad effect on our appearance. Collagen, which is responsible for skin density, is formed from amino acids coming from food. Fats are involved in forming the protective barrier of the skin and retaining moisture. Deficiency of trace elements such as zinc and iron often manifests through hair loss and a dull complexion.
Here are the key products to pay attention to if you want be pretty naturally:

items: Green vegetables;
Grains (buckwheat, rice, wheat);
Fruits (strawberries, bananas, citrus);
Red meat and liver (women need to consume enough of these products);
Fatty fish.

blocks.text: Mental Health and Stress Management

A lot depends on our mindset. Mindset is a fundamental factor of beauty. With a large amount of stress, the whole organism enters a special mode aimed at survival. Chronic stress increases the level of cortisol, a hormone that destroys collagen and increases inflammation. That is why stress can be called one of the factors that influence the ageing of the body. Skin texture worsens and a tendency to breakouts appears. Even the hair growth cycle is disrupted. Here are several practices to reduce the level of stress in your body:

items: [Breathing practices](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/breathwork-biohacking);
Reducing screen time;
Evening walks before sleep;
Add vitamin C to your daily routine. As [research shows](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28805671/) it reduces cortisol and helps with stress regulation.

Sleep Hygiene

[Sleep](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-sleep) is the foundation of our body. At this time, the body renews and restores itself. Often it is after sleep that we feel that an illness has receded, for example. It is very important to maintain a proper sleep cycle and not go to bed too late. It is also worth taking time to read before going to bed instead of using gadgets. Blue light from screens negatively affects the skin and eye condition. It also increases cortisol levels, which does not allow you to fall asleep calmly, and in the morning you will find dark circles under your eyes that no concealer can cover. Try to establish a ritual before sleep:

items: Put your phone away two hours before sleep;
Go for evening walks if the weather allows;
Ventilate the room where you will sleep;
Spray a special sleep mist on your pillow. They often contain lavender and mint, these essential oils help to relax and fall asleep faster;
Light an aroma candle and take a book. This will help switch attention and calm the mind.

blocks.text: Biohacking Skin Health

It is also important to devote time to facial care. As well as to all the skin on the body in general. The main stages of care include: cleansing, moisturising, individual selection of actives, and sun protection. Each of these stages is important to follow to prolong your natural youth. Active substances such as retinol, niacinamide, and acids affect cell renewal and texture levelling. But it is important to remember that they must be combined correctly. For example, vitamin C should not be combined with acids, but it will work well paired with peptides. And if you use retinol, then spend a few minutes on SPF in the morning, since although it is an effective anti-ageing component, it makes your skin more photosensitive.

Here are some more useful techniques that will improve your skin condition:

items: [Red light therapy](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/red-light-therapy-biohacking-methods-for-health-benefits) works on [rejuvenation and removes inflammation](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/19817517/). Thanks to it, you can activate collagen production and even out the tone;
[Cryotherapy](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-cryotherapy) helps maintain body tone and create additional firmness due to the cold temperature;

Face and body massage is an excellent part of advanced body care contribution to improving muscle function and the overall condition of the body. It helps to work out those internal muscles that we use little in everyday life. This is especially true for facial muscles. It is due to spasms of certain segments that we get expression wrinkles. [Massage](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/face-massage) helps make them less pronounced;

Sunscreen could maintain a youthful appearance. It has already been proven that ultraviolet and radiation from the sun directly affect the condition of our skin. In order to get vitamin D but protect yourself from the harmful effects of sunlight, make it a rule to use SPF.

blocks.text: Remember that even when the weather is cloudy, its rays can still affect the skin, so apply cream even in such weather during the period of active sun: starting from spring and ending in mid-autumn.
Biohacking Hair Health

Hair is one of the first to react to stress and in general, is an indicator of your health. As soon as you feel worse, they become thinner. Their growth also directly depends on the condition of the scalp and microcirculation. When the blood supply of the follicles is disrupted, the hair receives fewer nutrients. In addition to adjusting the functioning of the body as a whole, there are also more local ways to improve scalp function. Here are some methods:

items: Scalp exfoliation. This will help remove keratinised particles that prevent follicles from being properly nourished;
Massage, it will improve microcirculation and activate hair growth;
Rosemary oil. It is usually rubbed several times a week. Due to its properties, it activates hair growth and tones the scalp.

Posture

Posture performs far more than just an aesthetic function. It also affects how you are perceived in society. This is an opportunity to enhance your natural beauty​ for free as well. For example, a person with a straight back and open shoulders will be perceived as confident and competent. And if you slouch, it creates the impression that you are tired or insecure. Thus, you become less noticeable and it is harder to attract attention. Therefore, try to [work on your posture](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-for-posture) at least several times a week. Do a special set of exercises to strengthen your back and core. It is important to say that strength training for the whole body also helps improve posture, since quite often hyperlordosis and scoliosis are associated with the inability to keep the abdominal muscles toned.Improving posture begins with restoring muscle balance.

Most often, the problem is associated with weakened back muscles and an overstrained chest area due to a sedentary lifestyle. Strengthening the upper back, opening up the chest region, and working on the core gradually return the body to its natural position. Mindful movement practices are also beneficial. Slow alignment of body position throughout the day, and monitoring the position of the head relative to the spine. To notice results, dedicating 10-15 minutes a day to this is sufficient.
Additionally, in the biohacking approach, the following are used:

items: Joint mobility work
Stretching of the chest muscles
Core strengthening

blocks.text: Exercises such as the plank, “boat pose,” or shoulder blade retractions help stabilise the core and improve body position. Try reorganiыing your workspace. Position the screen and chair so that your back and neck do not strain during the day. Over time, the body will adapt to the new form, and you will notice improvement imperceptibly.
Biohacking for a Healthy Body Appearance

Often we devote a lot of time to the face and save on the rest of the body. This is fundamentally wrong, since the skin on other parts of the body also creates a certain impression of you. In order to keep the body young and healthy longer, include [training](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/fitness-and-biohacking) in your routine without fail. Cardio and strength training in combination give the best effect. Of course, it is important to choose the type of physical activity that you enjoy in order to make it part of your life.

At the [University of California San Diego](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/39846264/), the connection between physical activity and telomere length was studied. Telomeres are protective sections of DNA that shorten with age and are considered a marker of biological ageing. Scientists found that in people who regularly exercise, their telomeres were significantly longer than in sedentary participants. Thus, it was found that training can slow cellular ageing at the genetic level.
Anti-Ageing Biohacking

Natural aging is associated with the accumulation of oxidative stress and a decrease in mitochondrial efficiency. The rate of cell renewal and the overall condition of tissues depend on these processes. Biohackers try to [slow down these changes](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/how-biohacking-can-reverse-aging). For this, nutrition, activity, and recovery are adjusted. Antioxidants also help reduce cell damage. Physical activity supports mitochondrial function and metabolism. According to [PubMed](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/30065270/) data, mitochondrial dysfunction is one of the key factors of biological aging. This explains why biohacking approaches are aimed not only at external care, but also at supporting cellular energy. If you approach the process comprehensively, then potentially you can influence biological age, and not only external signs of ageing.
Biohacking Beauty Supplements

[Supplements](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/best-biohacking-supplements) are used as a tool to replenish deficiencies and support physiological processes. For example, in a [randomised clinical trial](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34405148/https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34405148/) it was shown that a combination of collagen and omega-3 reduces the level of inflammatory markers in the body. Reduction of inflammation is directly related to improving skin condition and slowing ageing processes. Let’s consider what other supplements can contribute to improving the functioning of the body:

items: Collagen can support skin structure with a sufficient level of protein in the diet;
Omega-3 fatty acids help reduce inflammation and improve skin condition;
Magnesium affects sleep quality and body recovery;
Vitamin D participates in the regulation of the immune system. Their effect is manifested not directly, but through the improvement of internal processes.

blocks.text: Summary

We have considered all the main factors that can affect your beauty. As you can see, in order to improve your condition, not so much is needed. Try to start by regulating your routine. Go to bed and wake up at the same time to stabilise your circadian rhythms and ground the body. Although it sounds banal, avoid stress. We have discussed why nutrition and physical activity are important for your youth and well-being. Of course, in the modern world it may be difficult to follow all the points, so if you feel difficulties, here is your checklist of beauty tips for natural beauty​ to put everything together:

items: [Meditate](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohacking-meditation). These practices change brain chemistry and allow it to let go of unnecessary thoughts;

[Practice yoga](https://www.biohackers.world/blog/biohackers-guide-to-yoga). Here you have the opportunity to pay attention to your joints and stretch your muscles. As the sages of antiquity said, it is in them that our youth is located;
Include supplements in your daily routine. Magnesium, lion’s mane, creatine will be useful in order to tune your body and give it additional strength and concentration

Use cosmetics with active ingredients and combine them correctly. Remember that, for example, retinol should be used only in the evening, and also remember the correct combination of acids and vitamin C;
Use SPF even if the day is cloudy starting from the first months of spring. The sun becomes more active at this time and your skin may become more photosensitive
Do not ignore proper sleep.
